name: slip_uart_tx
description: SLIP-framed UART transmitter, 8N1: the lane escapes END/ESC per byte and builds each 10-bit frame; FIRE starts shifter0 and timer0 together, each timer tick shifts one bit, shifter done stops the timer so the next frame starts on a fresh bit period. The line is output 0 (uio6), push-pull, idle high.

word_notes.0-1: timer0: 20 clocks per bit (first tick and period)
word_notes.2: shifter0: 10 bits, LSB first, no restart
